question_variants: What is the average order value?
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC(o.created_at, MONTH) AS month, AVG(oi.sale_price) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 36
report: Average order value by month, excluding cancelled and returned orders.
